policy.note: Public-safe remediation queue. A signal identifies a review priority and does not by itself prove the question is invalid.
policy.order: strong then moderate then watch; within level, larger outside-range difference first
policy.preservation: Preserve Question ID. Do not rewrite Published content outside the atomic remediation pipeline.
policy.source_reset: If remediation changes substantive legal/tax content of a source-verified question, source verification must be reset and performed again.
